notes:
A multi-step methodology was used to create this map, sourcing data from 19 districts/counties across Xiamen, Zhangzhou, and Quanzhou.

Data Collection
Bulletins 7, 2, and 1 of the 5th National Economic Census was collected per-district to obtain a subdistrict-level breakdown of employment in Greater Xiamen.

Spatial Assignment
Population and Employee data for each subdistrict based on the above bulletins were assigned to the geometry of each subdistrict using a Shapefile.

Geographical Processing - Stage 1
Data was disaggregated to the individual building level by assigning a building a usage metric based off of total commercial/residential volume within a Subdistrict, or by District using an industry-level breakdown and assigning based off of building type.

Geographical Processing - Stage 2
Data was aggregated up to a hexagonal grid with side length n=400m for commute modelling.

Commute Modelling
O/D pairs were created using a Gravity Model, the source for which can be found in the sources linked below.

Map Data
Map Data was fetched from OpenStreetMap, Overture, and 3D-GloBFP and processed by RSlurry's depot package.
